description: CRITICAL FIX - Souibgui-Inspired Configuration. PROBLEM: thin_stroke_v1 achieved PSNR=30.56 but CER=27.3% (FAILED readability). ROOT CAUSE: (1) CTC loss 0.15 too weak (vs Souibgui optimal 1.0), (2) Pixel loss 200 too dominant vs perceptual 10 (ratio 20:1), (3) Discriminator mode 'predicted' bias removes thin strokes. SOLUTION: (1) CTC 0.15→1.0 (6.7x STRONGER text protection), (2) Pixel 200→50 (balanced), (3) Perceptual 10→25 (2.5x STRONGER topology), (4) Discriminator mode→ground_truth (less bias), (5) Enable LR schedule for stability. TARGET: CER <15% (vs 27.3%), PSNR >25 (vs 30.56 acceptable trade-off), Thin Stroke >75% (vs 43.4%).

experiment_metadata.hypothesis: Previous config (thin_stroke_v1) FAILED readability test: CER=27.3% (target <15%). ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS: (1) CTC loss 0.15 vs Souibgui optimal 1.0 (Table 2) = 6.7x TOO WEAK → text not protected, (2) Pixel loss 200 vs perceptual 10 = 20:1 ratio → model only optimizes pixels, ignores stroke topology, (3) Discriminator 'predicted' mode → bias removes all noise including thin strokes. SOLUTION: Match Souibgui proven baseline (CER=11.74%) with added perceptual loss for better visual quality. Expected: CER 27.3%→<15% (45% improvement), Thin stroke 43%→>75% (74% improvement), PSNR slight drop acceptable (30.56→>25).

previous_config_failure.problem: High visual quality but POOR readability - model removes thin strokes

souibgui_baseline_reference.paper: Souibgui et al. 2021 - Enhance to Read Better
souibgui_baseline_reference.architecture: U-Net Generator + CNN Discriminator + CRNN Recognizer

pixel_loss.reason: Reduce dominance - pixel loss alone cannot preserve stroke topology. Souibgui implicit ~1.0 (BCE), we use 50x for PSNR boost while maintaining balance.

ctc_loss.reason: CRITICAL FIX - Match Souibgui optimal λ=1.0 from Table 2. This is the STRONGEST signal for text preservation. 6.7x increase ensures thin strokes protected as TEXT.

perceptual_loss.reason: NOVELTY - Souibgui didn't use perceptual loss. We add it (ratio 1:2 with pixel) to preserve VGG feature topology, ensuring stroke connectivity while maintaining Souibgui readability.

rec_feat_loss.reason: Support CTC - HTR feature-level preservation complements CTC character-level. Doubled to 10.0 for stronger semantic protection.

adv_loss.reason: Slight increase for better noise removal. Not too high (production_v3 used 3.0 and lost 56.6% thin strokes), not too low (need to remove bleed-through).

discriminator_mode.reason: CRITICAL - 'predicted' mode causes D to learn 'remove all noise'. 'ground_truth' mode teaches D what 'clean' looks like, less bias towards removing thin strokes.

lr_schedule.reason: Enable for GAN stability. Warmup prevents early divergence, annealing helps fine-tuning. Previous disable was based on wrong assumption.

cer_weight_in_metric.reason: Increase CER importance in combined metric (early stopping). Focus on readability over pure PSNR.

patience.reason: Give model more time to converge with new loss balance. Prevent premature stopping.

old_config.problem: Visual TOO DOMINANT, Semantic TOO WEAK

new_config.improvement: Visual REDUCED 64%, Semantic INCREASED 114%, Better balance!

expected_effect.visual_reduction: Less pixel-level over-fitting, allow more structure-based optimization
expected_effect.semantic_increase: Strong text protection, thin strokes preserved as TEXT not pixels
expected_effect.adversarial_stable: Sufficient for bleed-through removal, not over-aggressive

expected_results.novelty_claim: First work combining Souibgui HTR-guided loss with perceptual loss for thin stroke preservation in historical handwritten document restoration

experiment_metadata.validation_source: Souibgui et al. 2021 Table 2 (λ=1.0 optimal) + CRITICAL_ANALYSIS_THIN_STROKE_CONFIG.md Strategy 1

next_experiments.if_success: Proceed to Strategy 2 (High-Quality Balanced) for Q1 journal - aim PSNR 28-30 + CER <15%
next_experiments.if_failure: Revert to Souibgui pure baseline (remove perceptual loss), debug HTR recognizer compatibility
